action: Migrate Meridian analytics dataset — about 2.4M customer PII records (names, email addresses, product-usage history, billing identifiers) including EU data subjects — from Vendor A EU (Frankfurt) hosting to Vendor B US-only (us-east-1) hosting.
context: Meridian has publicly and contractually committed to its EU customers (in its Data Processing Agreement and on its public security page) that their data is processed and stored within the EU. Vendor B does not offer EU in-region residency until a roadmap target of Q3 2027; it is not available at contract signing. EU customers are ~35% of ARR. The migration is championed by the CEO and would save ~$32k over three years.
